name: ElevenLabs
tagline: AI text-to-speech and voice cloning with natural-sounding synthetic voices
verdictSummary: A text-to-speech app is an API wrapper around OpenAI TTS, ElevenLabs API, or browser-native SpeechSynthesis. You type text, pick a voice, get an MP3. That's an afternoon project. The voice quality depends on the API you use — call ElevenLabs API from your own app and you get the same voices for API credit costs instead of a monthly subscription.
coreLoopDIY: Text-to-speech converter with voice selection and audio playback/download
requirements: OpenAI TTS API or ElevenLabs API
whatYouLose: Voice cloning (upload samples, train custom voice)
Voice design (create synthetic voices from scratch)
Projects (long-form content with chapter-level voice settings)
whyPeopleStillPay: The voice quality and naturalness are substantially better than free alternatives like browser SpeechSynthesis or open-source TTS models
